mcdr-singleplayer.onboarding.intro:
Mod data is stored in mcdr-singleplayer under the game directory
The singleplayer host receives MCDR owner permission (level 4)
Plugin settings and data are stored separately by save folder name
After permanently deleting a save, remove its matching folder under .\mcdr-singleplayer\date
mcdr-singleplayer.python.required_intro:
This singleplayer world needs Python 3.10 or newer with pip
MCDR will start automatically after the installation is detected
mcdr-singleplayer.python.escape_hint: Press Esc to close this notice
mcdr-singleplayer.python.mcdr_install_in:
Python has been detected; MCDR and its required dependencies are being installed automatically
The current singleplayer world will connect when setup finishes
mcdr-singleplayer.python.mcdr_ready_intr:
Python has been detected
Automatic MCDR installation is disabled; check autoInstall in mcdr-singleplayer-config.yml
mcdr-singleplayer.python.install_instruc:
In Customize installation, keep the “pip” option checked on Optional Features
Also check “Add python.exe to PATH” on the first page when available
